description: XrmToolBox plugin that executes FetchXML and Web API queries against a Dataverse environment, serialises results to an intermediate JSON file, and uses an internal scripting post-processor to produce Markdown grounding files for non-agentic AI assistants.
releaseNotes:
1.2026.11.1

      NEW
      - Run All Specs: runs every spec in the list one after another, after a
        confirmation (a full run can take several minutes). A spec that fails is
        logged and the others still run; Cancel stops the batch. The result panel
        then opens the output folder.
      - PowerPages spec: Power Pages sites on the enhanced data model - the page
        map with URLs and the forms and lists each page shows, web roles and what
        each can do, table permissions, page access rules, basic forms, lists,
        multistep forms with their steps in flow order, cloud flows, Web API
        exposure, site settings, templates and navigation. Values of site
        settings that look like secrets are never read.
      - Relationships spec: the project's relationships with their behavior and
        cascade settings, Web API navigation properties and related menus, plus
        an index of lookups by table. SolutionsReference now lists each table's
        relationships.
      - Higher-resolution icons.

      CHANGED
      - The sample specs now describe what the project built or customized:
        unmanaged components, managed tables with project columns, forms or
        views, and components of project solutions. Run them against a
        development environment. On a large environment SolutionsReference now
        takes seconds instead of minutes, and its output is a fraction of the
        size.
      - SecurityModel shows each role as a table-by-action privilege matrix.
      - Cloud flows show their trigger; disabled plug-in steps and draft
        processes are marked as such.
      - New template function parse_json, for JSON text held in a column.

      FIXED
      - Forms and views were cut off at 5,000 records.
      - Empty publisher column; wrong form and view type labels; virtual tables
        not detected; multi-select, file and image columns shown as "-";
        application-required columns not marked as required; every security role
        listed under one "Root" heading.
      - Template parse errors now report line and column counted from 1.
      - Upgrading the reference configuration no longer discards your edits:
        a shipped file you edited is backed up first.

      UPGRADING
      - When the tool offers to update the reference configuration, choose Yes
        to get the new and updated specs. Any shipped query, template or spec
        you edited is backed up to config\backup\(previous version)\ before it is
        replaced. LEGAL.md and files of your own are never touched.
      - Coming from 1.2026.7.1 or earlier: if the Tool Library update fails with
        "The process cannot access the file ...System.Text.Json.dll", close every
        XrmToolBox window, delete the folder
        %AppData%\MscrmTools\XrmToolBox\Plugins\D365ContextExporter, start
        XrmToolBox and install the tool again from the Tool Library.
summary: XrmToolBox plugin to produce grounding files for AI assistants
title: D365 CE Context Exporter for XrmToolBox
